question: Could you help me calculate the average single career span value in years for all baseball players? Please precise the result as a float number. First, calculate the difference in years, months, and days between the debut and final game dates. For each player, the career span is computed as the sum of the absolute number of years, plus the absolute number of months divided by 12, plus the absolute number of days divided by 365. Round each part to two decimal places before summing. Finally, average the career spans and round the result to a float number.
sql:
WITH player_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    CAST(debut AS DATE) AS debut_date,
    CAST(final_game AS DATE) AS final_date
  FROM player 
  WHERE debut IS NOT NULL AND final_game IS NOT NULL AND debut != '' AND final_game != ''
),
date_diffs AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    debut_date,
    final_date,
    (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM final_date) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM debut_date)) * 12 
      + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM final_date) - EXTRACT(MONTH FROM debut_date) AS total_months,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM (CAST(final_date AS DATE) - (CAST(debut_date AS DATE) + (total_months * INTERVAL '1' MONTH)))) AS remaining_days
  FROM player_dates
),
adjusted AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    total_months,
    remaining_days,
    CASE WHEN remaining_days < 0 
      THEN total_months - 1 
      ELSE total_months 
    END AS adj_months,
    CAST(final_date AS DATE) - (CAST(debut_date AS DATE) + (adj_months * INTERVAL '1' MONTH)) AS adj_interval
  FROM date_diffs
),
career_spans AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    FLOOR(adj_months / 12) AS years,
    adj_months - FLOOR(adj_months / 12) * 12 AS months,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM adj_interval) AS days,
    ROUND(ABS(FLOOR(adj_months / 12)), 2) + ROUND(ABS(adj_months - FLOOR(adj_months / 12) * 12), 2) / 12.0 + ROUND(ABS(EXTRACT(DAY FROM adj_interval)), 2) / 365.0 AS career_span
  FROM adjusted
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(career_span), 2) AS avg_career_span
FROM career_spans
